To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: PM (Sr) attrition — coverage runway + cost-center swap / expedited comp-band decision

Hi team,

Quick heads up: Savannah handed in her notice yesterday (effective 5/3). She's the Sr PM on the Inference Runtime team (IC4). We need a short plan to avoid a 6-week feature and milestone slip while we decide whether to backfill at IC4 or re-level to IC5 given market comps.

Asks:
- Approve a short-term coverage runway: 3 weeks of contractor support + redistribution of two sprint stories to Eng. I attached a one-page runbook.
- Decision on band: recommend restoring the headcount at IC4 for speed, with a market-adjusted offer (top of band + 10% sign-on). If you prefer re-leveling to IC5 we need a headcount uplift and approval from Finance.
- Cost-center swap: can we move the role from Eng-GP-12 to Eng-GP-10 for this fiscal quarter to free budget?

I attached the JD, comp band snapshot, and the proposed runbook. This is time-sensitive — Savannah's last day means we need an approved approach by EOD Mon (4/20) to get candidates moving and the contractor engaged.

Thanks,
Lauren
--
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PM (Sr) attrition — coverage runway + cost-center swap / expedited comp-band decision

Thanks Lauren — sorry to hear Savannah is leaving. A few quick questions: 
1) Which two sprint stories are realistically movable without blocking the roadmap? I want to confirm with Eng leads.
2) If we go IC4 + top-of-band + 10% sign-on, what's the net budget impact for the quarter (including contractor)? Aditya can you run a quick delta?
3) If we consider IC5, do we have any internal candidates for promotion to backfill (faster approval), or would it be an external search?

Prefer keeping to IC4 unless there's a strong product reason to re-level; re-leveling will take longer. I'm supportive of contractor coverage for 3 weeks.

-Markus
--
Markus Klein
VP, Engineering
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PM (Sr) attrition — coverage runway + cost-center swap / expedited comp-band decision

I chatted with Bridgepath (external contractor agency) and they have two proven IC4 PM contractors available to start within 7 business days; hourly estimate attached in the runbook. For direct hire, I reviewed the comp bands and recommend the following:
- IC4 restore: base at 140k-170k (band), propose base = 168k, sign-on = 10k, target OTE comp aligned with band snapshot (see attachment).
- IC5 re-level: would push base target to 190k-220k; longer approval + add headcount delta of +1 FTE-equivalent for the quarter.

If we can do cost-center swap to Eng-GP-10 for this quarter I can push a fast-track req and start outreach to prior candidate pools.

Attachments referenced: PM_Sr_backfill_JD.pdf, comp_band_snapshot_Q1_2026.csv

-Marissa
Recruiting Lead
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PM (Sr) attrition — coverage runway + cost-center swap / expedited comp-band decision

Quick budget note: moving the existing headcount from Eng-GP-12 to Eng-GP-10 for Q2 is doable as a one-off (we can absorb the delta internally) but we need to log a cost-center memo for audit. Net delta for IC4 restore + 10% sign-on + 3-week contractor = ~$32k for the quarter. IC5 re-level would add ~+$58k and requires headcount uplift (we'll need FP approval).

If the goal is zero disruption, the IC4 restore + contractor is the fastest and cheapest. If you believe the product outcomes require IC5, we should schedule a brief sync with FP this week.

-Aditya
Finance Manager
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 15:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PM (Sr) attrition — coverage runway + cost-center swap / expedited comp-band decision

Thanks for the context. From a people/approval standpoint: 
- I can approve the IC4 backfill at top-of-band + sign-on as an HR fast-track (no additional headcount).
- Cost-center swap: HR approves the temporary move for the quarter; please route the memo to HR Ops and Finance (Aditya noted the audit record).
- If you choose re-level to IC5, we need a written business case and FP sign-off (this will take ~7-10 days).

Given the timelines, I recommend: 1) lock a contractor for 3 weeks today, 2) open an IC4 fast-track req with the proposed comp, 3) begin outreach to internal candidates for quick promotion possibility.

-Neha
Head of People Operations
